welcome.title: Welcome to Satis
welcome.body: In about a minute we'll set up your business and first location, so you can start hearing from your customers.

name.title: What's your business called?
name.hint: The name your customers know it by.
name.label: Business name

type.title: What kind of business is it?
type.hint: We use this to suggest questions that suit your customers.

location.title: Where is your first location?
location.hint: You can add more locations later.

survey.title: Create your first survey
survey.body: We've prepared a short survey customers can answer in under a minute. You can edit it any time.

qr.title: Your QR code is ready
qr.body: This is the code for {location}. Download or print it.

done.title: Put your QR code where it's easy to see
done.body: Place this QR code where your customers can easily see it.

tips.counter: Next to the cashier or payment point
tips.exit: Near the exit or on the receipt
